seguridad_ecuador.resumen: El CERT Polska de Polonia reportó tres vulnerabilidades críticas en MikroTik RouterOS: CVE-2026-67276, por omisión de autenticación SSH; CVE-2026-86060, que permite manipular privilegios mediante un nombre de usuario malicioso; y CVE-2026-67277, que puede provocar divulgación de memoria y fallos del sistema mediante una prueba de ancho de banda. Su explotación conjunta podría permitir tomar el control total del dispositivo sin autenticación, si el acceso remoto SSH está habilitado.

principales_cves.impacto: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service.

fuentes.resumen: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
